name: Battle of the Sexes
description: Coordination game with two pure NE and one mixed NE. Tests multiple-equilibria case.
source: Luce & Raiffa (1957). Games and Decisions, pp. 90-94.

mixedNashProfiles.derivation: P2 indifferent: p*1 = (1-p)*2 → p = 2/3. P1 indifferent: q*2 = (1-q)*1 → q = 1/3. Mixed NE: P1 plays Opera with prob 2/3; P2 plays Opera with prob 1/3.

notes: P1 prefers Opera; P2 prefers Ballet; both prefer coordination.
Mixed NE expected payoffs: both get 2/3, which is less than either pure NE.
